notes.title: Demo Update. Gameflow implements. Balance fixes.
notes.notes:
Greetings, players! We are thrilled to bring you an important update that enhances gameplay balance, AI behavior, and the overall experience. Here’s what’s new in this update:

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]

Fixed the issue where the game would crash upon exiting.

Resolved various enemy AI-related bugs, including movement speed inconsistencies and incorrect attack patterns.

Addressed UI issues such as card drag-and-drop glitches and missing buff icons.

Fixed incorrect enemy health calculations in higher difficulty levels.

[h2]Game Balance Updates[/h2]

[h3]Combat Mechanics Adjustments[/h3]

Card upgrade costs have been recalibrated: The initial upgrade cost is now 8, with subsequent costs increasing by 10% every four upgrades.

Enemy health now scales more dynamically across different rounds.

Post-time stop mechanics adjusted to prevent enemies from gaining an unfair advantage.

Stamina and guard mechanics refined for a more strategic experience.

[h3]AI Behavior Enhancements
[/h3]
Enemies will no longer remain idle for extended periods without reason.

If enemies enter an idle state, their next attack will be significantly more aggressive.

Improved edge detection for enemy movements.

[h2]New Features and UI Improvements[/h2]

Curse Cards: A new debuff mechanic where negative effects apply throughout the battle when these cards are present in your deck.

Decay: Lose 5 HP per second (stackable).

Confusion: 10% chance for abilities to be reversed (stackable).

Rage: 20% chance every 15 seconds to increase attack power but lose control for 5 seconds (stackable).

Fear: 20% chance every 15 seconds to take 25% more damage for 5 seconds (stackable).

Fatigue: 40% chance every 15 seconds to reduce stamina recovery speed for 5 seconds (stackable).

[h2]Enhanced UI/UX:[/h2]

Highlighted navigation buttons in the move set screen.

Improved readability and clarity of temple upgrade descriptions.

Combat results screen now utilizes a scroll view to prevent text overflow.

New Intro Cinematic: Added an exciting new animation to set the stage for the adventure!

Talent Tree and Reward Adjustments

Talent nodes have been restructured to emphasize strategic choices.

Guard bar damage reduction now only applies to players, making enemy fights fairer.

Combat rewards now differentiate more between temple rewards and in-battle bonuses.

[h2]Currently Working At[/h2]

1. Intro Clip's Audio Track.
2. Tutoral SFX Bug.
3. Will Hit problems.
4. Enemy AI Updating in progress.


[h2]Future Developments[/h2]

This is just the beginning! We are continuing to refine the gameplay experience and will bring more exciting content soon. Thank you for your support and feedback!

notes.title: [Version 0.8.2300+] Last Demo Update
notes.notes:
[h1]Core Game Updates[/h1]

We have completed all milestone updates for our game's gameplay. As of now, the demo will no longer receive updates!

[h2]Features and Gameplay Updates[/h2]

[h3]Talent Tree Ready[/h3]
The [b]Talent Tree[/b] system is now fully operational.
Players can customize their playstyle through the Talent Tree.

If you prefer thrilling and fast-paced combat, focus on increasing [b]Qi[/b] and [b]Qi Recovery[/b].

If you prefer strategic gameplay and counter-attacks, invest in [b]Poise[/b] and [b]Poise Recovery[/b], and so on.

[h3]UI and Tutorial Updates[/h3]
We have once again updated the [b]UI[/b] and [b]Tutorials[/b] to ensure new players have the best possible experience.

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
Numerous bugs have been fixed to improve overall gameplay stability.

[h2]Upcoming Plans[/h2]

After this update, we will stop updating the demo.
Moving forward, we will focus on [b]enemy AI[/b] and [b]boss fights[/b]. Stories will be added after we start selling the game or find a good publisher.

We truly need your support to boost the game's wishlist count! If you enjoyed the demo, please help us reach more players by adding the game to your wishlist.

Thank you so much for your support!

Best regards,
[b]CotS Dev Team[/b]

notes.title: [Version 0.8.2200+] What we have done so far and what is coming next.
notes.notes:
[h1]🎄 Merry Christmas and Happy New Year! 🎆[/h1]

This year, we’ve made significant updates to our game’s gameplay and mechanics. Based on internal testing and guest feedback, we’ve transformed the original time-stop-based battle system into an exciting QTE-inspired system.

[b]👉 Try out our demo now and experience the changes![/b]

[h1]🎮 What Have We Done Since the Last Announcement[/h1]

Previously, we tried blending the thrill of fighting games with the strategy of card games. However, feedback highlighted the conflicts between these elements.

After a lot of trial and error, we’ve developed a new design that better suits [i]Chronicles of the Soulforged[/i].

[h2]Gameplay Changes[/h2]

[list]
[*][b]Two Separate Phases:[/b]
[list]
[*][u]Fighting Period:[/u] Engage in "KoF"-style 2D fighting gameplay. Whoever wins the exchange earns the chance to play cards.
[*][u]Card Play Period:[/u] Draw cards, strategize, and execute the best possible combo strikes.
[/list]
[/list]

[h2]Mechanics Updates[/h2]

[list]
[*][b]Poise System:[/b] Characters now have Poise, reducing damage taken in the Fighting Period. When Poise drops to zero, the attacker triggers the Card Play Period.
[*][b]Card Updates:[/b]
[list]
[*]Cards can be assigned as [b]Fighting Moves[/b] or [b]Combo Moves[/b].
[*][u]Fighting Moves:[/u] Used during the Fighting Period, bound to specific keys (e.g., Left-Click, Right-Click). These act like light and heavy punches in traditional fighting games.
[*][u]Combo Moves:[/u] Includes Triggers, Follow-Ups, and Finishers.
[list]
[*][i]Triggers:[/i] Make the next card free to play.
[*][i]Follow-Ups & Finishers:[/i] Gain special effects when their cost is free.
[/list]
[*][b]Killing Combos:[/b] Completing a combo with all three Combo Moves enhances the Finisher’s effects and damage.
[*][b]Customizable Combos:[/b] Players can assign any cards to any moves.
[*][b]Blessings:[/b] Adjusted to work seamlessly with the new system.
[*][b]Damage Types:[/b] Each type has unique effects against Poise and specific Combo bonuses.
[/list]
[/list]

[h2]Other Updates[/h2]

[list]
[*][b]Beginner-Friendly Adjustments:[/b] Fewer starting cards to simplify the early game. Unlock more as you progress.
[*][b]Improved UI/UX:[/b] Redesigned elements to make gameplay clearer.
[*][b]Visual Guides:[/b] Added visual effects to help players track ongoing effects and mechanics.
[/list]

[h1]🚀 What’s Coming Next[/h1]

[h2]1. Damage Stats[/h2]

Blessings are becoming so powerful that some players are surprised at how much damage they can deal through Killing Combos! To help players understand these boosts, we’re adding a [b]Damage Review Page[/b] at the end of battles.

This page will summarize:
[list]
[*]Total damage dealt.
[*]Contributions from Blessings, cards, and other factors.
[/list]

This will help players optimize their builds for maximum effectiveness.

[h2]2. Talent Tree[/h2]

We’ve received mixed feedback on the gameplay—some players want smoother combat and more aggressive enemies, while others prefer a stronger card game focus.

To address this, we’re introducing a [b]Talent Tree[/b]:
[list]
[*]Customize the game to suit your playstyle.
[*]Boost [b]Qi Gain Rate[/b] for a more fighting-game-like experience.
[*]Increase [b]hand size[/b] and [b]Qi cap[/b] for more powerful combos during the Card Play Period.
[/list]

[b]Features:[/b]
[list]
[*]15 unique upgrade types.
[*]Randomly generated Talent Trees for each run, ensuring variety.
[*]Some trees may even lead to hilarious or chaotic builds, like super-fast movement speeds!
[/list]

[h2]3. The Incense Burner[/h2]

Bad luck can sometimes make it impossible to find the key cards you need. To counter this, we’re adding the [b]Incense Burner[/b]:
[list]
[*][i]Sacrifice cards[/i] to the Burner to gain unique passives.
[*]Each card type offers [b]three different passives[/b].
[*]Passives last a few battles but provide significant boosts to your power.
[/list]

[h1]📢 Big Announcement[/h1]

As [i]Chronicles of the Soulforged[/i] approaches completion, we’re focusing on creating more content for the official release. Some updates may not appear in the demo.

[h2]Want to Help?[/h2]

If you’d like to participate in more playtests, contact us:
[b]📧 Email:[/b] [url=mailto:xiaozj1992@yahoo.com]xiaozj1992@yahoo.com[/url]

Join our Discord community:
[b]Discord:[/b] [url=https://discord.gg/7SmWyCzq]Click Here[/url]

We also actively monitor our community pages—leave your comments and suggestions there!

Thank you for playing [i]Chronicles of the Soulforged[/i]! 🎮

notes.title: Version 0.7.1772: Visual Updates, New Enemies, Tutorials and Gameflow Changes.
notes.notes:
Hi All,

As the fundamentals of gameplay near completion, we are starting to improve the overall presentation of the game.

Here is what we have improved from the previous version:

[h2]Tutorials[/h2]

In the previous version, we neglected to teach players some of the game mechanics, resulting in complaints that the game was too unfair and lacked counterplay options.

Therefore, we adjusted our gameplay and updated our tutorials based on those player feedbacks.

New players will be required to choose the "Spear" as their initial weapon to learn the game's basic controls.

"Sword and Shield" will teach players how collision works in the game and how to utilize collisions to their advantage.

"Bow and Arrow" will teach players the core mechanics of the game, including the Card Queue system, and introduce them to "Traps."

We hope the updated tutorial and game flow will greatly improve new players' experience.

[h2]Visuals[/h2]

We updated some visuals in the game to enhance in-game feedback:

Dazed: Characters under the Dazed effect are forced to clear their playing queue and are unable to play any cards for the duration.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44324938/ddc0a15dbb279c76648b4bf4ab86b260979aab19.png[/img]

Bleed: Bleed causes characters to lose a percentage of their health every 10 seconds.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44324938/67a0fe33d4701074afb7f0683d726144b3659f12.png[/img]

Time-Stop: Players can use Time-Stop to extend the decision-making time.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44324938/cac3274c787b70e48b5692303aa142551b8b133e.png[/img]

[h2]Replay is Ready![/h2]

We have struggled to make this work since the beginning. Thanks to the hard work of our dedicated engineers, the replay feature is now available in the Demo.

With this version, players will be able to watch instant replays of their entire fight.

We hope this will greatly increase satisfaction after winning each fight. :)

[h2]New Enemies[/h2]

Despite our limited time, we have managed to add two new enemies to the game in this version.

[h2]The Next to Come[/h2]

[h3]Visuals[/h3]We are experimenting with ways to improve the in-game atmosphere, including sounds and VFX. In the coming month, lighting effects will be added to environments and characters.

[h3]Story Mode[/h3]Story Mode will be designed as a 1000-health challenge. It will be difficult, but we aim to perfect the player experience. Although completing even one chapter of Story Mode in the next month might be challenging, we plan to add some teasers in the Duel Mode.

[h3]Enemies[/h3]Minions are almost ready. We still have 3-4 bosses left to create. Developing boss fights requires extensive iterations to meet expectations, which might take at least two months of work.

[h3]Storyline Integration[/h3] We are working on re-designing Level-Selection section to match the storyline. Both In-game environment and UIs will be re-designed to match the storyline progress.
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Thanks again for keeping track of our game!

Stay tuned and have fun with the Demo!

Best,

CotS Dev Team

notes.title: Version 0.7.1667 is out live on Demo
notes.notes:
Greetings our potential friends and players!

It's been a while since last update, here is what we have been doing so far!

[h2][b]Game Content:[/b][/h2]

[h3][b]Bow and Arrow :[/b][/h3]

Bow and Arrow are now playable.
This weapon is focusing on planning ahead. Utilizing traps, teleporting and long range shooting to defeat the enemy is the designed way of playing it. 
Please be aware that Bow and Arrow has extremely slow moving speed. 
Feel free to use Time-Stop to buy you infinite amount of decision time!

[h2][b]Blessings[/b][/h2]

We've add numerous new blessings and keywords into the game.
A special leveling system for blessings is live now on the Demo version.

[h2][b]Action Cards[/b][/h2]

All action cards have different attack type now.
There are 4 attack types in total: Slash, Blow, Piece and Heavy.
Different attack type has different interaction with each other!

[h2]Monetary and Growth System Update[/h2]

We've improved the entire monetary system and growth system.
[b]Coins are used to obtain new Blessing only, while Leave points are used for everything else![/b]
In this version, player should feel much smoother with the difficulty curves.

[h2]Come and try it out yourself![/h2]

We are looking forward to your feedback and suggestions!

===========================================================

Future Updating Path:

We are still focusing on perfecting the whole gameplay flow and interactions!
After that, we will start adding in new enemies and bosses!

We will start updating Stories enable story mode AFTER Duel Mode is completed !
[h2]
We hope our demo is good enough for you to add us into your wishlist!![/h2]

[h1]Thank You ![/h1]

notes.title: Hello Everyone! Our demo is available now!
notes.notes:
ːsteamhappyːːsteamhappyːːsteamhappyː

We're thrilled to announce that the demo version of Chronicles of the Soulforged ("CotS") is now available for download! While the entire demo is not yet complete, we wanted to give you a sneak peek into the immersive world we've been crafting.

Download the demo now and embark on an unforgettable gaming experience. Although we're still fine-tuning certain aspects, the core game mechanics are in place, allowing you to get a feel for the gameplay and atmosphere we've created. Your involvement at this stage is incredibly valuable to us, as we're eager to hear your thoughts and feedback to make this game even better.

As we move forward, we see this demo as a bridge of communication between our development team and you, the players. We're committed to actively listening to your feedback and taking your suggestions into consideration. Stay tuned for a short guide that will be released later this month. It will provide you with valuable information about the game's unique features, controls, and gameplay mechanics. We want to ensure you have all the tools and knowledge you need to fully immerse yourself in our game world.

We are truly excited to have you on this journey with us. Feel free to reach out to us with any questions, comments, or ideas you may have. We'll make sure to reply to you as soon as possible.

Thank you for your support, and let the adventure begin!

Best regards,
CotS Dev Team
